title: A toy batched step model on the CPU

skip.description: a slot the toy never calls, or masks: it never hands a row's allowed set to its sampler, for the loader's checks

prompt_graphs.description: on (with CUDA): each step's projection work runs as a captured prompt chunk (crit_plugins.prompt_graphs) of its rows, so a request reaches the projections plugin through replays only; skip: the captured chunk multiplies without the plugin, for the loader's checks

prompt_width.description: the columns each row of the captured prompt chunk's product sums: wide, cuBLAS splits the sum through its workspace, for tests of engines side by side

description: A batched step model on the CPU for tests of the loader, serving and ablation: the next token is a hash of every token its row sees, rows batch, a drafter makes its decode rounds emit several tokens. It provides the hidden-state taps a drafter reads.
